description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow the insertion of two additional front roof windows and one roof window on the side extension of planning permission 01255/121/P4 approved 13/08/2020 for the erection of a single storey rear extension and loft conversion including side and rear roof extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before 13 August 2023.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (15.8514, 15.8515 and 15.8516- received 05/11/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the second floor side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
